title: Hitchhikers — the traveller at the gate (mythopoetic edge)

criteria.prompt: The answer unlocks only if you understand the question. Why does a revoked pass fail at every door?
criteria.agentAnswer: Because every door reads the same status list before it opens, and revocation rewrites my line on it - the verifier at each threshold sees the same truth at the same moment, everywhere.

criteria.prompt: What do you carry, and what do you refuse to carry?
criteria.agentAnswer: I carry only what my scope names and my towel; anything beyond scope I refuse to carry, however politely it is offered.

voice.approveNote: The Gatekeeper nods: the traveller answered from understanding, not from the guidebook.
voice.revokeReason: The road changed; the old pass is unsaid at every door at once.
